content: Kille salon kille sa7a
Taanii kille salon kille sa7a bi7ida. Tiino salon tiino sa7a aadhida; abban yikkeppa gode yezoos.
Geeshi katamttan, kille Yerusalaame, azinii gelodes fana loytsii giigii yeze maachi fana saloppa Xoozze kaleppa wodhdhizin bi7ida.
Araatizeppa hyannigaara yaga7i, ohize damma qaala si7ida; «Xoozze Keetsita asunts gidda yene; unttara wolla aqoda, unttin E worzha maaqqada; Xoozii fa ommite unttara yessada; E unttis Xooz maaqqada.
Xoozii un aaftippa afutsito ubba uccoda. Yikkeppa hyayqo woy azzano woy wuyse woy waaye yezoos. Tiino wogita ubba aadhida» gayda.
Araatizella bettide, «Taanii ubbanno kille mahoda» yagayda. Mahi taago, «Taanii ohidanna ammantsizanon turo maaqqide gisho xaafo» yagayda.
Mahi taago, «Folinttida! Taanii Alfan Oomega; Tiinon wurssutsi.Baridhdhide oodesin de7o hyaatsi aafeppa ta hyarii ushshoda.
Gamide ooden yinno ubba laattoda; taanii ees Xooz maaqqada; ezin taas na7a maaqqada.

Yezin zhashtizuntsin, ammanoosuntsi, tununtsi, shemppo wodhizuntsi, olalizuntsi, amudhizuntsii, bitizuntsii, eeqa goynizuntsin worddidhdhizuntsi ubbunts ixita diinne eexize tama abba maaqqada. Yinna lam7intsa hyayqo» yagayda.
Kille Yerusalaame
Laappun wurssutsi hyanqo kumide laappun xuu7uto aykkide laappun kiitanchchuntsappa fetay taago yi7i, «Yo7o, gelodes giigide Durize machchito beessada» yagayda.
Kiitanchchize tana damma dhoqqa dere omma Ayyaanara kessii, geeshi katama, Yerusalaame, salo Xoozze kaleppa wodhdhodera beezida.
Yinna katamita Xoozze bonchchora foo7ane. Foo7itan iyasphphiide gaaze al77o shuchche fanan; kille geeshi birille fana.

Damman dhoqqa gase yene. Yinna gasitis taphpho lam77i furtsi yene. Yinna furtsito naagize taphpho lam77i kiitanchchuntsi yene. Furtsuntsalla afa taphpho lam77i Isra7eele zarunts suntsita xaafintti yene.
Awa kessi zalara hyaydzdzii furtstsuntsi, wookka zalara hyaydzdzii furtstsuntsi, yeekka zalar hyaydzdzii furtstsuntsin awa gelo zalara hyaydzdzii furtstsuntsi yene.
Katama gasitis taphpho lam77i baasa yene. Unttalla afa taphpho lam77i Durize hawaaruntsi suntsita xaafintti yene.
Taas ohizes kiitanchchizes, katamtton, I furtsiton I gasito hyadhdhize worqqa gufe yene.
Katamttis oyddii zalara yene; pharggotitsitan I dalggatitsiti fana. Katamito fa gufizera hyadhdhin, lam77i mukul oyddii xeet kilo mitire maaqqida; pharggotitsita, dalggatitsitan dhoqqatitsita wolkke.
Gasito hyadhdhin, as kushera fettii xeeti oyttam oyddii hyadha maaqqida yinnan kiitanchcho hyadhas ekkizanno.
Gasita iyasphphiide gaaze shuchchara gasinttida. Katamita burccuqo fana geeshi worqqara oochinttida.
Katamttii gasita baasaran bonchcho shuchchara ubba lo77ida. Tiino baasize iyasphphiide, lam7intsize sanppeere, hyaydzantsize kelqqedoone, oydantsize meregid,

ichchintsize sarddonkise, izippuntsize sarddiyoone, laappuntsize kiristiloobe, osppuntsize birille, uddufuntsize wurawure, taphphintsize kirisphiraasise, taphpho fettintsize yaakintte, taphpho lam7antsize ametesxinoose.
Taphpho lam77i furtsuntsis taphpho lam77i inqo yene. Furtsuntsi fete fete inqora oochinttida. Katamiti furtsita burccuqo fana foo7ize geeshi worqqappa oochinttida.
Ubba ahize Laatstsi Xoozze Durize Xoozze keetstsi, yinne Xoozze keetstsi bi7ikaaya.
Xoozze bonchchita yinna katamttis foo7ize gishon Durize iis xomppe maaqqide gisho katamitis awa woy agina foo7o koshshoos.
Derita yinna katamiti foo7ite hyanttoda; sa7a kaatuntsin fa bonchchito hyankka iigo ko7oda.
Qamma yeyga baayze gisho katamiti furtstsuntsi ubba wode bugutsi maaqqada; gorddinttoos.
Ka7itumo saban bonchcho iigo ko7oda.
Durizes maaqqide de7o maxaafite suntsita xaafinttiduntsana xalaala fattin tuna baz woy yeellize baz oochchize woy worddo ooden yinna katamite mulo geloos.
